text:
[IARC.3.5.1] Executes the RHS of a fired rule. Dispatches the
action verbs (`log`, `call`, `emit`,
`publish`, `cache_*`) to the correct
downstream surface — a registered integrator callback,
inline `wm` mutations, recorder entries. Dispatch is
synchronous into integrator code; there is no outbound
queue ([IARC.2.3]). Also handles
the `refraction` bookkeeping the agenda needs to pick
the next activation.
